**[P2] Model authoritative empty carrier values in the public type**

The documented call passes `xRayTraceId` even when it is `undefined` or `null`, but this signature permits only `string` when present. `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` rejects `string | undefined`, and strict TypeScript always rejects `null`, so callers cannot represent states whose precedence this helper implements. Widen the carrier value accordingly, normalize `null` in `selectXRayTraceHeader` while preserving property presence, and add an `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true` declaration test.
